title: Authority to plan, improve, develop, operate, and maintain industrial parks.
bodyText: The board shall plan, improve, develop, operate, and maintain each industrial park designated pursuant to section 171-132. The planning, improving, developing, operation, and maintenance of an industrial park shall be in accordance with this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§171-133]  Authority to plan, improve, develop, operate, and maintain industrial parks.  The board shall plan, improve, develop, operate, and maintain each industrial park designated pursuant to section 171-132.  The planning, improving, developing, operation, and maintenance of an industrial park shall be in accordance with this chapter. [L 1988, c 361, pt of §1]
